root_authority: One bounded saved-data experiment on existing TRAIN32 L7-14; shared lowparameter innovation adapter and paired network-blocked CV; no captures or models.
features: Physical30 plus returned recurrent state64, one shared coefficient vector across all eight layers and one intercept.
target: e_l - gate_l*(e_(l-1) @ W_l), where e is truth_mean minus native predicted mean; divide by native sigma for regression.
training_weight: sigma squared divided by TRAIN network-layer innovation MSE, pooled normalization; train-only feature mean/population std floor1e-6.
evaluation: Held-out innovation residual after nonnegative output clamp; accumulate one mean correction per layer through frozen gate-W transport to terminal native gate. Terminal surrogate only; no native gain claim.
advance: At least 0.8 percent geometric terminal surrogate gain before root considers one fixed native8.
forbidden: No coefficient/ridge/shrink/layer sweep, no new models/captures, no exported coefficients.
